title: The Mirror Image Appears
next_chapter_hook: "When the figure exactly like himself spoke, Chen Ji heard a name that made his soul tremble — Chen Jie, the twin name, the calamity of the mirror."

text.content: "Pitch-black eyes floated in the center of the Void, their pupils reflecting Chen Ji's figure. That was no ordinary divine sense probing — it was a gaze transcending space, as if Heaven's Dao itself was observing, with a spectator's detachment, the most restless piece on the chessboard. Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill spread from his tailbone to the crown of his head, the Tianji Record Fragment quivering violently within his body, as if warning of some crisis capable of incinerating destiny."

dialogue.content: "Insect... you dare to peer into Heavenly Secrets?"

text.content: "The voice did not emerge from the eyes, but resounded directly in the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea, ancient, authoritative, devoid of any emotion. The pitch-black eye's pupil contracted slightly, a fissure slowly tearing open from within — not a rift in space, but some higher-dimensional passage. Demonic energy surged forth like a tide from the fissure, carrying pressure enough to crush mountains, completely repelling the spiritual energy within several li."

dialogue.content: "(Inner cold laugh) Finally willing to step onto the stage yourself?"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not retreat a single step. Standing with hands clasped behind his back, he calmly gazed at that floating giant eye, even a faint smile curling at the corner of his lips. He knew too well — the appearance of the Heavenly Dao's Eye meant his plans had touched some critical point. That he could provoke such a reaction before Heavenly Will... should Chen Ji feel honored, or should he feel fear? The answer: neither mattered. What mattered was, he had already come this far."

"Before the words even finished, the black fissure suddenly expanded, and a figure slowly stepped out from within. That person wore an ivory-white robe identical to Chen Ji's, black hair cascading down, features handsome yet bearing a certain sinister pallor. His eyebrows, his contours, his stance — exactly like Chen Ji as if viewed in a mirror, down to the smallest detail. The only difference was that deep within that person's eyes flowed mysterious patterns of the same source as the Tianji Record Fragment, but presenting a completely opposite hue — pitch-black as ink."

"Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. This was the first time since beginning his cultivation that he truly felt the meaning of 'losing control.' The Tianji Record Fragment shuddered violently within his body, as if responding to some summoning from the depths of his bloodline. He could clearly sense — this person before him had indestructible ties to him. It wasn't simple similarity, but something deeper, transcending the fleshly body. Blood Pulse resonance surged like a tide, causing violent turbulence in his Mental Sea."

dialogue.content: "Curious? Chen Ji... you've finally seen me."

text.content: "The person — or rather, that mirror image — walked closer, demonic energy forming ferocious black dragon patterns around him, each step stepping on Chen Ji's heart. His voice was identical to Chen Ji's, yet carried acold与amused漠和amused of having experienced the vicissitudes of ages. 'Did you think you were the only variable in this chess game?' He stopped three zhang away from Chen Ji, pitch-black eyes reflecting Chen Ji's shocked face, 'Pathetic piece... you don't even know what you are.'"

dialogue.content: "(Forcing down his state of mind) Who are you?"

text.content: "Chen Ji's voice was steady even to his own surprise. Years of playing the pig to eat the tiger had trained him to maintain surface composure in any situation, even as his heart churned with monstrous waves. The aura of this 'self' before him was too bizarre — it was clearly Tianji Record energy, yet presented properties completely opposite to the Fragment. Two sides of one coin, mirror-born. His mind raced through what Mo Xiansheng had once said, some deliberately ignored detail now frantically battering his cognition."

choice.prompt: "Facing a mirror existence identical to himself, Chen Ji had to make a choice:"

choices.description: "Stop hiding his shock, directly ask the other party's origins and what connection they share."
choices.risk_hint: "The other party may use this to probe your bottom line"

text.content: "The mirror image heard this, a playful arc curling at the corner of its mouth, that expression identical to Chen Ji yet revealing an unsettling evil aura. 'Identity?' It stepped forward, black Tianji patterns churning in its eyes, 'My name is Chen Jie — the calamity twin-born with you.'"

choices.description: "Don't answer directly, instead defend to attack, infer their strength and purpose by observing their reactions."
choices.visible_reward: "See through the other party's trump cards"
choices.risk_hint: "The other party may be better at endurance than you"

text.content: "Chen Ji said nothing, merelyslightly侧身，做出一副防御的姿态。His gaze swept across the demonic patterns around the other party, trying to find weaknesses. However Chen Jie seemed to have anticipated this, instead spreading his arms wide, revealing a warm smile identical to Chen Ji's — that was Chen Ji's usual camouflage, yet now seemed so ironic. 'Want to see my trump card?' Chen Jie's voice carried mockery, 'Your Tianji Record can see three hours ahead, but I... can see three thousand years.'"

choices.description: "Use sharp words to probe the other party's bottom line while observing emotional changes, seeking opportunities."
choices.risk_hint: "Infuriating the other party may lead to uncontrollable consequences"

text.content: "The corner of Chen Ji's mouth lifted, revealing a sharp smile utterly different from his usual weak image. 'Three thousand years?' His voice carried undisguised mockery, 'Lived for three thousand years, yet still a creature hiding behind the Demonic Path? If you truly had ability, why need to appear via the Heavenly Dao's Eye?' As the words fell, Chen Jie's playful expressionslightly一滞，那转瞬即逝的裂痕被陈机尽收眼底。'Anxious?' Chen Ji smiled even more deeply, 'So I was right.'"

"Chen Jie's pupils contracted slightly, that momentary emotional fluctuation vanishing in an instant, yet Chen Ji captured it with precision. 'You're more interesting than I anticipated.' Chen Jie quickly恢复了amused的笑容，周身魔气却不由自主地fluctuation了一瞬——那是血脉共鸣带来的本能反应，即便强如他也无法完全压制。'However, you should have already sensed it, no?' He raised his hand, pitch-black Tianji patterns emerging in his palm, 'The blood connection between us... every time your Tianji Record activates, I can sense it.'"

"Chen Ji's mind raced. Heavenly Fate — every time he used the Tianji Record, he not only consumed lifespan but also risked being perceived by this 'self.' What did this mean? Every one of his prophecies, every move in his plans, might be transparent to the other party. Yet Chen Jie's next words caused his thoughts to completely halt. 'Aren't you curious?' Chen Jie stepped closer, black and white Tianji patterns intertwining in the air, 'Why was the Tianji Record chosen for you, not me? Why are we twin-born yet destined to oppose each other?'"

"Chen Jie's footsteps faltered, that face identical to Chen Ji's displaying an ineffably complex expression — there was unwillingness, there was venom, and even a trace of... sorrow that Chen Ji could clearly sense. 'Lost?' He laughed lowly, that laughter carrying hatred that three thousand years could not erase, 'Heaven's Dao chose you, I was merely the discarded defective product. It needed a white piece, so it needed a black piece to maintain balance. You and I... were always its playthings.'"

choice.prompt: "Facing the shocking truth Chen Jie revealed, Chen Ji had to respond:"

choices.description: "Since we are two sides of one coin, might as well try to recruit them as an ally, jointly opposing Heavenly Will."
choices.risk_hint: "The other party's three-thousand-year obsession won't easily dissipate"

text.content: "Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then stepped forward, gazing at Chen Jie. 'Since Heaven's Dao treats us as chess pieces,' his voice was calm and certain, 'why must we play by its rules? You hate it, I hate it too. Rather than be its white piece and black piece, let's overturn this chessboard.' A flicker of surprise crossed Chen Jie's eyes, then transformed into deep scrutiny. 'Interesting... you're more like the chosen one than I am.'"

choices.text: "Question the truthfulness of the other party's words"
choices.description: "What Chen Jie said may not be true, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's projection still exists, cannot rule out the possibility this is a trap."
choices.risk_hint: "The truth may be crueler than lies"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not respond immediately. His gaze passed Chen Jie, looking toward the floating pitch-black eye above. 'Three thousand years...' He suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a trace of sarcasm, 'You keep saying Heaven's Dao is unfair, that I was chosen and you were discarded. But if what you say is true, you had three thousand years to strategize, the Demonic Path army, the Heavenly Dao's Eye backing you — why must you still appear in person now, speaking these words to me?' Chen Jie's expression微僵。'What are you afraid of?' Chen Ji's voice如刀，'Or... what are you waiting for?'"

choices.description: "No matter what the other party says, Chen Ji's only response is — he will be no one's chess piece, Heaven's Dao's included."
choices.risk_hint: "May provoke direct intervention from the Heavenly Dao's Eye"

text.content: "Chen Ji stepped forward, the Tianji Record Fragment's power surging within him, golden Tianji patterns emerging around him, forming stark opposition to Chen Jie's black patterns. 'White piece, black piece?' His voice was terrifyingly calm, 'Chen Jie, you misunderstood one thing — I was never anyone's chess piece.' His momentum攀至顶点，even facing the Heavenly Dao's Eye's pressure, even facing an enemy with three thousand years of accumulation, his eyes still held no retreat. 'I'll accept this chess game. But how it's played, is for me to decide.'"

"Chen Jie fell silent. That face identical to Chen Ji's churned with complex emotions like tides. There was scrutiny, there was surprise, and even a trace of... wariness intimidated by Chen Ji's momentum. He slowly withdrew the demonic energy around him, pitch-black Tianji patterns fading into his body, returning to that original serene appearance. 'Interesting.' He murmured, 'It seems this three-thousand-year wait was not in vain.' He turned, back facing Chen Ji, yet his voice clearly entered Chen Ji's ears: 'The outcome between us need not be rushed. Chen Ji, I look forward to... the day you personally overturn this chessboard.'"

"The fissure tore open again, Chen Jie's figure stepping within, demonic energy receding like a tide. That floating pitch-black eye also slowly closed, as if having lost interest in this play. However, in the final moment before the eye completely vanished, Chen Ji clearly saw a flicker of... laughter within those depths. That was not Chen Jie's laughter, but the Heavenly Dao's Eye itself — as if saying: everything, still lies within its control. The pressure dissipated, heaven and earth returned to silence. Chen Ji stood alone, night wind brushing past, stirring his white garments. His fingers trembled slightly — that was the afterecho of Blood Pulse resonance, and also a warning of the approaching storm."

dialogue.content: "(Inner) Chen Jie... twin-born... a three-thousand-year chess game..."

text.content: "Chen Ji深吸一口气，强迫自己calm下来。Mo Xiansheng's remnant soulslightlyfluctuation in his Mental Sea,似乎想要说什么，却又强行按捺住了。That old fox... Chen Ji心中sneered。He dared bet Mo Xiansheng absolutely knew of Chen Jie's existence, even knew more truths he had yet to reveal. But now was not the time to interrogate. Tonight's events were too numerous — the Heavenly Dao's Eye's projection, the mirror Chen Jie's appearance, the shocking secret of twin birth — each sufficient to overturn his original understanding. He raised his head, gazing toward the horizon. The east was already泛起一丝鱼肚白，a new day was coming. And he, Chen Ji, was about to embark on the most perilous journey of his cultivation path."
